reports.title: Butterfly Network Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: Raised revenue guidance and adjusted EBITDA guidance for the Fiscal Year 2026:
•Revenue of $123 million to $126 million, or approximately 26% to 29% growth
•Adjusted EBITDA loss of $12 million to $15 million
Provided revenue guidance and adjusted EBITDA guidance for the 4th Quarter of 2026:
•Revenue of $31 million to $34 million, or approximately 3% growth year-over-year at the midpoint
•Adjusted EBITDA loss of $3 million to $6 million

Reconciliations of gross profit and gross margin to adjusted gross profit and adjusted gross margin and of net loss and EPS to adjusted net loss, adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted EPS for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and 2025 are provided in the financial schedules that are part of this press release. An explanation of these non-GAAP financial measures is also included below under the heading “Non-GAAP Financial Measures.”
